column6: Generational leap in graphics and DualSense haptics
column7: The custom Gen4 NVMe SSD completely eliminates loading screens in Spider-Man 2 and Demon's Souls. The DualSense haptic feedback and adaptive triggers add visceral immersion you have to feel to believe. Whisper quiet cooling.
Games look breathtaking on an OLED TV with HDR and 120Hz VRR support. Interface is slick and 3D audio through Pulse 3D headset is positional pinpoint accurate.
Backward compatibility with PS4 games at 60fps is a massive plus. Storage expansion slot for M.2 SSD makes adding 2TB seamless.

column6: DualSense analog stick drift after 5 months
column7: Both included DualSense controllers developed severe left stick drift within 5 months of normal play. Characters move on their own. Potentiometers wear out way too fast. Sony needs Hall effect sticks.

column6: Massive chassis barely fits in entertainment unit
column7: The console is absurdly tall and bulky. You definitely need vertical clearance and open airflow to prevent heat accumulation in TV cabinets.

column6: Internal power supply spark and burning circuit smell
column7: Loud pop and sparks came out of the rear exhaust vent while playing Final Fantasy XVI, followed by heavy chemical smoke. Console died immediately. Breaker tripped. Severe electrical fire hazard.

column6: Severe overheating thermal shutdown with liquid metal leak
column7: Console was shutting down after 15 minutes with 'PS5 is too hot' warning. Service shop found liquid metal thermal compound had pooled at the bottom of the APU heatsink due to vertical standing. Catastrophic overheating.
Loud electrical coil whine buzz that can be heard across the room during high GPU load. Sounds like high-voltage arcing.

column6: The pinnacle of handheld PC gaming
column7: The 7.4-inch 90Hz OLED HDR display is drop-dead gorgeous. Deep inky blacks and vibrant colors make Cyberpunk 2077 look stunning. The revised fan is virtually silent and battery life is doubled over the LCD model.
Sleep and resume function works instantly like a Nintendo Switch. Full access to my entire Steam backlog. Ergonomic grip is comfortable for hours.
Dual haptic trackpads make mouse-driven strategy games like Civilization playable on a handheld. Emulation performance up to PS2/Switch is stellar.

column6: Too heavy for extended handheld sessions without propping
column7: Weighs nearly 640 grams. While ergonomic, holding it up in bed makes your wrists fatigue after an hour. Definitely a chunky handheld.

column6: AAA games still chew through battery in 2 hours
column7: Indie games like Hades run for 7-8 hours, but demanding titles like Baldur's Gate 3 drain the 50Wh battery in under 2.5 hours at full TDP.
After 4 months of heavy play, the internal battery swollen so much that the rear casing seam split and the right shoulder trigger jammed. Major safety hazard.

column6: 45W USB-C charger plug melted inside port
column7: The included 45W power adapter melted the plastic casing inside the top USB-C charging port. Smoke and scorched smell filled the room. Had to RMA entire unit.
